items.html: Not that the Concealed Brain itself gives power to AVI, for his level is very great. But the matter is, in what is explained above, that all the revelation of the Concealed Brain is in the thirteen Tikkunei Dikna of AA; and then, through the arousal of the lower Yesod of Arich, the Concealed Brain is aroused, and then the power of the Concealed Brain is drawn into the beard. And there are there the two Mazalot: the eighth, and the thirteenth; and the eighth is the aspect of the Tifferet in the beard, and the thirteenth is the aspect of the Yesod, included of male and female. And then the eighth Mazal, which is male, called the Daat within it, bestows to the thirteenth Mazal, which is female; and afterward that drop is given to AVI, who are influenced by these two Mazalot. And then, when ZON are in the secret of Ibur in AVI, the Mazal of the beard is aroused in its clothing within AVI, and then they bequeath Mochin fit for birth to the heads of ZA and his Nukva. And soon we shall explain that also the Netzah and Hod of Atik Yomin are aroused, and see there.
